summary: Iteration 3 validated the new Follow-up (private notes + callback_date) feature on the Admin Dashboard end-to-end via browser UI on the preview URL. Seeded admin session (tok_view_1 → drarifa@ysaindore.com) and ensured a Priya Sharma enquiry exists. All 5 acceptance criteria pass: (1) /admin loads admin-dashboard with table + Follow-up column, (2) admin-followup-{id} opens dialog exposing followup-date-{id} and followup-notes-{id}, (3) filling date=2026-02-15 + notes then clicking followup-save-{id} closes dialog, shows 'Follow-up saved' toast, and Follow-up button label updates to '15 Feb', (4) after full page reload the button still shows '15 Feb' and GET /api/admin/enquiries returns notes='Call after school hours; interested in Class 8 batch.' and callback_date='2026-02-15', (5) changing status via admin-status-{id} to 'contacted' does NOT erase notes/callback (verified via API: status='contacted', notes intact, callback_date='2026-02-15'). Test data reset after run.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby — console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Accessibility nit only, not a blocker.

action_items: Optional a11y: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to the Follow-up dialog to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx FollowUpButton: optimistic update in saveNotes() does not roll back on adminUpdate failure — a transient PATCH error would leave stale local state while showing no toast success (only try/catch would surface). Consider try/catch with rollback + toast.error.

callback_date stored as raw ISO date string 'YYYY-MM-DD' (no timezone) and rendered via new Date(...).toLocaleDateString('en-IN'). In some locales this can shift by a day due to UTC parsing. Consider parsing as local date explicitly.

success_rate.backend: not tested this iteration (skipped per request)
